## Clinical Specialties
- **Orthodontics & Braces**: Metal braces, ceramic (clear) braces, clear aligners, lingual braces, retainers. Average completion time: 7–11 months. Free initial consultation.
- **Root Canal (RCT)**: Painless rotary endodontics using NSK Endo-Mate DT micro-motors, digital apex locators, chairside digital X-rays, single or two-sitting RCT, Re-RCT.
- **Prosthodontics & Implants**: Zirconia metal-free CAD/CAM crowns, bridges, titanium dental implants, complete & partial flexible dentures.
- **Cosmetic Dentistry**: Teeth whitening, composite bonding, gap closure (diastema fix), fractured tooth restoration, porcelain veneers.
- **Oral Surgery**: Atraumatic wisdom tooth removal, surgical extractions, pre-orthodontic space extractions.
- **Periodontics & Gum Care**: Ultrasonic scaling, tartar removal, stain polishing, bleeding gum treatments.
- **Pediatric & Family Dentistry**: Child dental exams, fluoride treatments, pit & fissure sealants, milk tooth fillings, space maintainers.
